_README: Budgets for tools/perf-select.mjs. EVERY VALUE STARTS null AND THAT IS
DELIBERATE: a budget nobody measured is a number somebody invented, and
CLAUDE.md forbids exactly that. While a value is null the gate MEASURES and
TO FILL THEM: run `node tools/perf-select.mjs` on the CI runner (it needs a
real chromium and the basemap, so it cannot run in the sandbox), read the
numbers it prints, and set each budget somewhere above the observed value —
far enough that ordinary runner variance does not trip it, close enough that
a real regression does. Then record the observed baseline in NOW.md so a
later session can tell 'this got worse' from 'this was always like that'.
worstTaskMs   the longest single main-thread block during one storm
selection. This is the number that maps to 'it feels
sticky' — one 200 ms task is a visible hitch, and an
blockedMs     total main-thread block across the whole selection window.
toDetailMs    wall clock from the tap to the detail panel being on screen.
Reported for context; it can look fine while the thread is
jammed straight after, which is why it is not the headline.
